quick_facts.sprint_goal: Build the product catalog + frontend scaffold. Cashiers can manage SKUs with VNĐ pricing and VAT rates.

content.tldr: Sprint 2 active. Building product catalog (backend T001-T005) + frontend scaffold (T006-T009). Sprint 1 closed: auth + store done, 11 tests green.
content.sprint_notes: Sprint 1 CLOSED 2026-04-12. Velocity 2/2. Auth: JWT access (15m) + refresh (7d, Redis rotation), bcryptjs cost 12, RolesGuard, @Public() bypass, admin seed. Store: CRUD, taxCode immutable, soft-delete, deactivation session flush. 2 migrations. 11 unit tests green. BUG-0001 (medium, fixed) + BUG-0002 (high, fixed). Docker 6-service stack operational. wiki-app 10 routes passing.
